title: Steelers GM Omar Khan: We hope Joey Porter Jr. finishes his career here

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steelers GM Omar Khan: We hope Joey Porter Jr. finishes his career here
sources.description: The Steelers activated cornerback Joey Porter Jr. from the physically unable to perform list on Sunday, which clears the way for Porter to practice with the team and play in Week 1 even though he has not received the contract extension he's been looking for all offseason.
